# Measurement Requirements Quality Checklist: F03 V2 runner

**Purpose**: Review timing, evidence and lifecycle requirement quality before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-10-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by the actual speckit-checklist workflow, initially unchecked.
**Review Ownership**: Reviewer-owned. Under the authorized autonomous workflow the assigned planner performs the artifact review in a separate pass.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means requirements quality is reviewed and satisfied; it never means implementation passed.

## Completeness and consistency

- [x] CHK001 Are all four mode durations, stream choices and pause counts explicitly stated? [Completeness, FR-002/008/009]
- [x] CHK002 Are exact native settings, receiver metric authority and persistent-server ownership consistent? [Consistency, FR-003/004/012]
- [x] CHK003 Are retained trial/chunk identities distinguished from independent launches? [Clarity, FR-001/008/009]
- [x] CHK004 Is notification plus two seconds distinguished from actual overlap evidence? [Consistency, FR-005/006]

## Timing and measurability

- [x] CHK005 Is loaded short coverage quantified with the requested receiver duration, >=99% time coverage and a gap-aware union definition? [Measurability, FR-007]
- [x] CHK006 Are warm-up, omission, native filtering, process time and measured time separated? [Clarity, FR-006]
- [x] CHK007 Are unavailable/coarse native anchors and uncertain clock estimates handled without fabricated precision? [Coverage, FR-006/007]
- [x] CHK008 Are the unchanged day 86400/99%, generation 95% and clock 100 ms gates recorded as separate policies? [Consistency, FR-007]

## Failure, storage and boundaries

- [x] CHK009 Are missing/split/stale notifications, cancellation, early exit and bounded shutdown covered? [Coverage, FR-005/011]
- [x] CHK010 Is day probe failure distinguished from TCP failure, with no TCP restart or automatic campaign retry? [Clarity, FR-009/011]
- [x] CHK011 Are exclusive local files, incremental output, partial evidence and post-run close requirements explicit? [Completeness, FR-010]
- [x] CHK012 Are F01R-only dependencies, F09 integration and F08 validation ownership stated without a new shared sidecar requirement? [Dependencies, FR-012]
- [x] CHK013 Are fake-process/clock acceptance boundaries distinguished from real-cloud/tool proof? [Acceptance quality, FR-013/SC-005]

## Notes

Focus: timing/evidence and process failure boundaries. Depth: standard, mandatory protocol details. Actor/timing: planner as authorized artifact reviewer before implementation. Hooks absent. The implementation stage reads checklist markers and must not change them. The separate built-in requirements checklist has the specify/clarify lifecycle.

Separate authorized artifact-review pass: 13/13 requirements-quality criteria satisfied after clarifying canonical controller artifact projection. No implementation status is asserted.
